title: Weighted and unweighted regularity of bilinear pseudo-differential operators with symbols in general Hörmander classes
summary: This paper investigates the boundedness of bilinear pseudo-differential operators with symbols in the Hörmander class $BS_{\varrho,δ}^m(\mathbb{R}^n)$ in the previously unexplored regime $0 \leq \varrho \varrho$ permitted, and generalizes previous results of Park and Tomita to distinct exponent pairs. Consequently, we obtain weighted norm inequalities for bilinear pseudo-differential operators under multilinear $A_{\vec{p},(\vec{r},\infty)}$ weights.
